name: CREATE_TOPIC
description: Create a new topic on the Hedera Consensus Service (HCS). Topics act as message streams — any account (or only authorized ones if a submit key is set) can publish messages. The operator key is used as admin key by default.

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Operator key is set as admin key by default
implicitBehaviors.details: Uses agent.privateKey.publicKey for setAdminKey(). A custom admin key can be provided via adminPrivateKey input.

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Submit key is only set when requireSubmitKey is true
implicitBehaviors.details: If requireSubmitKey is true, setSubmitKey() is called with either the provided submitPrivateKey's public key or the operator's public key. If false/omitted, the topic is open (anyone can submit).

implicitBehaviors.behavior: Custom admin key requires additional signing
implicitBehaviors.details: When adminPrivateKey is provided, its public key is used for setAdminKey() and the private key signs the transaction after freezeWith().

inputs.name: memo
inputs.describe: Short description of the topic's purpose

inputs.name: requireSubmitKey
inputs.describe: If true, only the operator (or provided key) can submit messages. Default: open to all.

inputs.name: adminPrivateKey
inputs.describe: Admin key (only if different from operator key)

inputs.name: submitPrivateKey
inputs.describe: Submit key (only if different from operator key). Only used if requireSubmitKey is true.

successData.name: hasAdminKey
successData.describe: Always true — admin key is always set

successData.name: hasSubmitKey
successData.describe: Whether a submit key was set (based on requireSubmitKey)

errorMap.details: Transaction signature is invalid. Check your keys.
Not enough HBAR to cover the transaction fee.
The auto-renew duration is outside the allowed range.
